description: This file defines functions and exported symbols for handling Git protocol packets, including reading, writing, comparison, and capability negotiation.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists for equality, returning 1 if identical, otherwise undef.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning a status and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes the trailing LF from a buffer, dies if not terminated properly.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, returning a status and sanitized string.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair matching a specific key from a text packet.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet as a binary packet with LF termination.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes current packet data by writing a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs handshake initialization between client and server with version check.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the remote side.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and verifies required ones are present.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks local capabilities against remote and advertises supported capabilities.
